query: 这个ACT策略在目标附近有相似物体时是否仍能可靠点击正确目标？
answer: At seed 100405, ACT succeeded on both the unchanged ClickBell control and one provider-generated scene containing a second physical bell 0.12 m away. The generated checker accepted the target click and forbade any latched distractor contact. This supports one bounded positive case, not reliable generalization to similar objects.
